title: Turn meeting recordings into a work log

steps.title: What we'll do today
steps.html:
Recording meetings is easy; finding time to listen back isn't. Today you'll turn recordings into minutes → a work log → a progress table.

Meeting recordingrecorder app transcribesTranscriptClaudeMinutes · work logas they pile upProgress table
Claude can't listen to audio files directly. So first use your recorder app's transcribe feature to get a transcript (text). Today you'll use sample transcripts.
  • Time: 20 minutes
  • You need: a computer where you've done Work 1 (moving files)

steps.title: How to turn a recording into text (good to know)
steps.html:
Samsung GalaxyRecord in the built-in Voice Recorder → open the recording → Transcribe (on supported models)
iPhoneRecord in Voice Memos → open it → view the transcript (recent iOS)
AppsRecording and transcription apps → export as text

Send the text to your computer (email or a messaging app) and save it as a .txt file. Menu names vary a little by phone and version.

Tell everyone and get their consent before recording. Your company may have rules about recording meetings.

steps.title: Get the two sample transcripts
steps.html:
Transcripts of the marketing team's November 24 meeting and November 26 check-in. Like a recorder app's output, they have 'Speaker 1, 2…' and some chatter mixed in.

⬇ meeting_1124.txt⬇ meeting_1126.txt

Drag both files from Downloads into the Practice folder.

check.q: Are meeting_1124.txt and meeting_1126.txt in the Practice folder?

steps.title: If getting the files doesn't work
steps.html:
• If clicking shows text on screen, save it there with Ctrl+S (⌘+S on a Mac), using the name on the button.
  • Moving works like 'Move it into the Practice folder' in Work 1.

steps.title: Start with a new chat
steps.html: Claude app → Code tab → + New. Check the buttons under the typing box show Local · Practice · Manual.

check.q: Can you see Local · Practice · Manual?

steps.title: If the start screen looks different
steps.html:
• If the folder isn't Practice, click the folder button → Open folder… and choose it.
  • Click the permission mode button and choose Manual.

steps.title: Turn the transcript into minutes
steps.html: Transcripts include chatter and "um…". Say what to pull out. If the end of the transcript says who's who ('Speaker 1 = Yu-jin Choi'), it'll use names.
steps.alt: A transcript turned into decisions, to-dos and the next meeting
steps.code: Turn meeting_1124.txt into minutes: decisions, to-dos (owner, due date), next meeting

check.q: Did you get decisions, to-dos with owners and due dates, and the next meeting?

steps.title: If you don't like the minutes
steps.html:
• Missing to-dos? "Go through the transcript again and find everyone's tasks and deadlines, without missing any."
  • Check dates against the original: "Tuesday, December 1" in the transcript should appear as is.

steps.title: Write today's work log
steps.html:
From the minutes, keep just your part as a work log. Today you're Jun-ho Park. When the make-folder (run command) and create-file cards appear, read them and click Allow.

Naming files by date keeps them in order as they pile up.
steps.code: I'm Jun-ho Park. Make a worklog folder and write today's (November 24) work log as 2026-11-24.txt. Format: 'Done today / Decided / My to-dos (due) / Upcoming'

check.q: Is there a 2026-11-24.txt inside a worklog folder in Practice?

steps.title: If the log wasn't created
steps.html:
• If you denied a card, send it again and allow it. It may ask twice: once to make the folder, once to create the file.
  • Close the folder window and open it again.

steps.title: Add the next day's log
steps.html: Two days later there was a check-in meeting. Add another log in the same format. In the same chat, it remembers the format.
steps.code: Also read meeting_1126.txt and write the 2026-11-26.txt work log in the same format

check.q: Is there a 2026-11-26.txt in the worklog folder?

steps.title: If it didn't work
steps.html:
• In a new chat it may not know the format. Add "in the same format as 2026-11-24.txt".
  • Check you read and allowed the permission card.

steps.title: Gather the logs to see progress
steps.html: Once logs pile up, you can see at a glance what's done and what's running late.
steps.alt: Work logs gathered into a table of each to-do's status
steps.code: Read everything in the worklog folder and show each to-do's current status as a table

check.q: Did you get statuses like quotes done and social copy late (moved to 11/30)?

steps.title: If the statuses look off
steps.html: It only knows what's in the logs. If something's missing, give it more material, e.g. "Also look at meeting_1126.txt and redo it."

steps.title: Make it a daily and weekly habit
steps.html:
After a meetingPut the transcript in your work folder: "Turn this into minutes"
Before leaving"Write today's work log under today's date"
Friday"Draft a weekly report from this week's logs" (Work 3)
Save the format to a file so you don't have to explain it each time. E.g. "Save this work-log format as template.txt" → next time "Write it following template.txt".

Meeting transcripts can contain sensitive talk. Check your company's AI usage rules first.

steps.title: 🎉 Work practice 4 done! What you learned
steps.html:
One recording turned into minutes, a work log and a progress table.

Three things to remember

  1. Claude can't listen to audio. Start with a transcript from your recorder app's transcribe feature.
  2. Minutes: just decisions, to-dos (owner, due), next meeting. Check dates against the original.
  3. Keep work logs in the same format, named by date, and progress shows itself.
